primary-fill.note: The chosen/go fill: primary buttons, selected name rows. Near-black on paper, near-white at night.

surface-outline.note: 1.5px, full opacity, on cards, tiles, sections and outline buttons.

locked-fill.note: Solid fill behind a locked/disabled row. Replaces every opacity-based disabled state.

stat-good-ink.note: Wickets taken, active selection. Bright #22C55E is banned as bare text.

stat-warn-ink.note: Economy, strike rate, result lines. Bright #F59E0B is banned as bare text.

display-score.purpose: The runs/wickets pair on the hero tile, in the user's chosen bundled face (68px w900 tabular, never below 52px).

headline.purpose: Sheet titles and empty-state headlines, uppercase w900 16px.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked captions, section bands and keypad subtitles (9-11px w900).

title.purpose: A person's name in a row, a team name (w800 15px).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pointer-down feedback; the fill darkens immediately rather than rippling.

motion.name: overlay
motion.purpose: Sheet settle and the new-over fade; 120ms fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: celebrate
motion.purpose: Numeral-only boundary/wicket celebration. Transform, Opacity, ShaderMask, text shadow only.

motion.name: strip-glide
motion.purpose: Ball strip scroll after a delivery. Never runs on undo.

breakpoints.name: bento-stack
breakpoints.note: Two-up control pairs stack below this width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every confirm/start action. primaryFill slab, onPrimaryFill w800 label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--primary-fill,#131316); color:var(--on-primary-fill,#fff); border:none; border-radius:8px; min-width:64px; min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:0.5px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline alternative for the second action in a pair. 1.5px structural border, never a 2px one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--on-surface,#0A0A0A); border:1.5px solid var(--surface-outline,#0F172A); border-radius:8px; min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#E2E8F0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1D4ED8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: One meaning only: this destroys something. Used by ABANDON MATCH and archive delete.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background:#B91C1C; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; min-height:52px; padding:12px 16px; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; }

components.name: Keypad Key
components.description: 72dp rapid-input key: big numeral, 9px caption, instant darkening press state.
components.css: .ds-key { background:#15803D; color:#fff; border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.24); border-radius:14px; height:72px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-key-num { font-size:24px; font-weight:900; line-height:1; } .ds-key-sub { font-size:9px; font-weight:800; } .ds-key:active { background:#0f5c2b; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #131316; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Name Row
components.description: The only way a person is drawn. 48dp target, name w800, subtitle in onSurfaceVariant. Selected = solid primaryFill slab. Locked = solid lockedFill with a lock glyph, never a faded row.
components.html:
Ravi Patel
Right-hand bat • Off spin
Rohit Sharma
3 matches
Sanjay
just bowled
🔒
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:48px; padding:9px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-row,#CBD5E1); font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-row-name { font-size:14px; font-weight:800; color:var(--on-surface,#0A0A0A); } .ds-row-sub { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:var(--on-surface-variant,#475569); } .ds-row--sel { background:var(--primary-fill,#131316); border-bottom-color:var(--primary-fill,#131316); } .ds-row--sel .ds-row-name, .ds-row--sel .ds-row-sub { color:var(--on-primary-fill,#fff); } .ds-row--locked { background:var(--locked-fill,#E2E8F0); color:var(--locked-ink,#0F172A); } .ds-row--locked .ds-row-name, .ds-row--locked .ds-row-sub { color:var(--locked-ink,#0F172A); } .ds-row-dot { width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #475569; } .ds-row-dot--on { border-color:#fff; background:#fff; } .ds-row-lock { font-size:12px; }

components.name: Bento Tile
components.description: Compact state-first control tile: 10px w900 label in onSurfaceVariant, control beneath. Two sit side by side and stack below 360dp.
components.css: .ds-tile { background:var(--surface,#fff); border:1.5px solid var(--surface-outline,#0F172A); border-radius:12px; padding:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; } .ds-tile-label { font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:1.2px; color:var(--on-surface-variant,#475569); } .ds-tile-value { font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:26px; font-weight:900; text-align:center; color:var(--on-surface,#0A0A0A); }

components.name: Rule Chip
components.description: Two-state rule toggle. Active is a saturated primary fill (never near-black); inactive is a surface fill with a 1.5px structural border. The state is always written out.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; min-height:44px; padding:6px 8px; border:1.5px solid var(--surface-outline,#0F172A); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--on-surface,#0A0A0A); font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:900; line-height:1.2; } .ds-chip--on { background:var(--primary,#1D4ED8); border-color:var(--primary,#1D4ED8); color:#fff; }

components.name: Ball Badge
components.description: 36dp solid circle, no border or glow. Colour alone carries the event.
components.html: W+264WD0
components.css: .ds-balls { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-ball { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:12px; } .ds-ball--w { background:#DC143C; color:#fff; font-size:10px; } .ds-ball--six { background:#EC008C; color:#fff; } .ds-ball--four { background:#15803D; color:#fff; } .ds-ball--wide { background:#FFBA08; color:#000; } .ds-ball--dot { background:#131316; color:#fff; }

components.name: Derived Figure
components.description: Wickets and economy as text. Deep ink, or a pill fill carrying deep ink; never bright green/amber on a surface.
components.html: 3 W 7.50 ECON 3 W
components.css: .ds-stat-good { color:var(--stat-good-ink,#14532D); font-weight:900; } .ds-stat-warn { color:var(--stat-warn-ink,#92400E); font-weight:900; } .ds-stat-pill { background:var(--stat-good-fill,#DCFCE7); color:var(--stat-good-ink,#14532D); border:1px solid #15803D; border-radius:4px; padding:1px 5px; font-weight:900; }

components.name: Scoreboard Hero
components.description: Umpire Pro preset hero: team chip, 68px tabular numerals, hairline, three-up stat row.
components.html:
GULLY KINGS
184/3
OVERS16.4/20
CRR11.04
EXTRAS7
components.css: .ds-hero { background:#1D4ED8; border-radius:16px; border:1.5px solid #0F172A; padding:16px 20px; text-align:center; color:#fff; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-hero-team { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius:20px; padding:6px 16px; font-size:13px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px; } .ds-dot { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#22D3EE; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.26); } .ds-hero-score { font-size:68px; font-weight:900; line-height:1.05; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; margin:6px 0; } .ds-hero-slash { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-hero-rule { height:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.25); margin:6px 0; } .ds-hero-stats { display:flex; justify-content:space-evenly; } .ds-hero-stats > div { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size:10px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:2px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); } .ds-stat-value { font-size:18px; font-weight:900; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Structural-bordered surface, 16px corner, elevation 2 with no visible shadow. Border 1.5px at full opacity so it still reads in sunlight.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--on-surface,#0A0A0A); border:1.5px solid var(--surface-outline,#0F172A); border-radius:16px; padding:16px; font-family:Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

narrative.overview: CricScore is an arcade scoreboard that happens to be a phone app. It is used outdoors, standing, at arm's length, by one person who is simultaneously watching a ball and being asked for the score. Every visual decision answers that scene: solid saturated fills instead of tints, near-black or white text instead of greys, and numerals large enough to read from a metre away. The interface is loud where the match is loud (boundaries, wickets, the hero score) and deliberately silent everywhere else — settings, rosters and archives are dense, plain, and free of ornament. Both a paper theme and a night theme ship, so every rule is a role that flips rather than a light-mode hex value.
keyCharacteristics: Solid saturated fills, near-black/white text, no pastels, no low-contrast grey body copy.
Locked and disabled states are solid fills with full-contrast ink and a lock glyph, never an opacity.
Structural borders are 1.5px at full opacity; row dividers are 1px at full opacity.
Bright green and bright amber are never bare text on a surface.
Names are rows, never pills; controls are 8px rectangles, never pills; only badges, dots and avatars are circles.
Reading order is one column of content, but control pairs (stepper tiles, XI columns) sit 2-up and stack under 360dp.
Motion is layout-frozen: numerals animate with Transform/Opacity/ShaderMask only.
Every interactive target is at least 48dp; every icon-only control has a tooltip.
One coherent screen-reader sentence per scoreboard, not a pile of bare numerals.

rules.name: The Sunlight Rule
rules.body: Every fill is a solid saturated colour carrying white or near-black text. No pastels, no low-alpha tint as the only signal, no grey-on-grey. If a state can only be read by a subtle shade change, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Locked-Not-Faded Rule
rules.body: Never express disabled, locked, already played or just bowled with opacity. A 45%-alpha name is a smudge in daylight. Locked rows get a solid lockedFill, full-contrast lockedInk and an explicit lock glyph; the subtitle says why in words.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Tint Rule
rules.body: Body copy, captions and subtitles use a real ink (onSurface, onSurfaceVariant, lockedInk), never onSurface with an alpha multiplier. Opacity on white ink over a saturated fill is allowed; opacity on dark ink over a light surface is not.

rules.name: The Event Colour Rule
rules.body: Crimson, magenta, green, amber, purple and cyan mean a cricket event. They are never used for decoration, headings, or generic emphasis.

rules.name: The One Numeral Rule
rules.body: Tabular figures on every number that can change while it is on screen, so a live score, overs count or economy never jitters as digits change.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A new surface gets a border before it gets a shadow. Structural borders are 1.5px solid surfaceOutline; row rules are 1px solid borderRow. Nothing in this app is distinguished by blur.

rules.name: The Single-Column-Of-Content Rule
rules.body: Reading order is one column, top to bottom. That is not a ban on a 2-up arrangement of controls: two stepper tiles, two rule columns or two XI columns may sit side by side, and should when the alternative is a scroll. Side-by-side content stacks under 360dp rather than crushing a name or a 44dp target.

dos: Do read every colour through context.tokens / context.colors and every gap through context.spacing.
Do express selection as a solid fill with onPrimaryFill text, at w800 or heavier.
Do express locked/disabled as lockedFill + lockedInk + a lock glyph and a written reason.
Do use statGoodInk / statWarnInk for derived figures.
Do keep names as rows and controls as 8px rectangles; use circles only for badges, dots and avatars.
Do align numeric columns across every table in a sheet.
Do let control pairs sit 2-up and stack them under 360dp.
Do add FittedBox(fit: BoxFit.scaleDown) around any fixed-height/fixed-width text block so a 2x system text size shrinks instead of overflowing.
Do wrap a multi-number readout in a single Semantics(excludeSemantics: true, label:) with a sentence a person would say out loud.
Do confirm every destructive action, and name what is not deleted.
Do keep celebrations inside Transform, Opacity, ShaderMask, text colour/shadow and Positioned overlays; honour MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf.
donts: Don't write Color(0x…) in lib/screens, or add a role-less colour.
Don't dim text with opacity — not 0.45, not 0.4, not 0.3.
Don't draw a structural border thinner than 1.5px or a row rule at partial alpha.
Don't put bright green or bright amber as bare text on a surface.
Don't introduce a pastel, a low-alpha tint state, or grey-on-grey body text; that is the Sunlight Rule failing.
Don't use crimson, magenta, green, amber, purple or cyan for anything that is not a cricket event.
Don't add a page transition, hero animation or layout-size change to anything that moves on a live score.
Don't hide a destructive action behind a collapsed trigger, or let a swipe dismiss a sheet with unsaved edits.
Don't put a stub where a bar is: no resume() after stop(), no placeholder assets, no runtime font or CDN fetch.
Don't use a hint as a label, and don't hide the only explanation of a format inside a placeholder that disappears when typing.
Don't add a new style preset, celebration or score font without wiring it into StylePreset.presets / MatchStore.celebIds / ScoreFonts.ids and the settings sheet in the same change.
Don't add a network call, a live-room viewer, a runtime font fetch or a CDN asset.
